title: FLICKER 3D Printer Prototype
overview: Custom 3D printer prototype exploring printer architecture, open-frame electronics testing, and structural trade-offs in rapid prototyping.
scope: Custom 3D printer build, open-frame systems verification, electronics integration, and planned acrylic enclosure expansion.
materials:
• 3D-printed and structural frame components
 • Printer electronics (mainboard, stepper motors, drivers — implied by a custom 3D printer build)
 • Planned (not yet installed) acrylic panels for a future enclosure
fabricationSteps:
1. Design the printer's frame and motion system architecture.
 2. Source or fabricate structural components for the open frame.
 3. Install and wire the electronics (mainboard, steppers, drivers, hotend/bed electronics).
 4. Verify all systems (motion, heating, electronics) function correctly in the open-frame configuration.
 5. Calibrate and run test prints to validate printer performance.
 6. Document the printer's current open-frame state and note enclosure panels as a planned future addition once systems are fully verified and acrylic funding is secured.
outcome: Delivered a functional 3D printer prototype operating in an open-frame configuration with photo assets and a video demonstration.
